title: decree install / list / export --format json
description: What `decree install`, `decree list` and `decree export --format json` print on stdout, one shape per `action`. On failure (a name neither in plugins/ nor official, a plugin that fails its schema, a missing `needs`) nothing is printed on stdout, nothing is written, the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. `decree install` with no argument is the exception: it installs every plugin it can, prints `sync`, names each invalid plugin on stderr and exits 1. An install never refuses over a change: what it would lose goes to .decree/archive/ first. Reference: docs/reference/plugins.md.

action.description: `decree list`: the project's plugins, the machines no plugin installed, and the official plugins it does not have.

version.description: This decree's version, whose official plugins these are.

description.description: Its machine's one-line `description`, or its body's first line for a library; empty when it fails its schema.

official.description: Whether decree ships an official plugin of this name.

differs.description: With `official`: whether the file differs from this decree's copy, byte for byte (edited, or from another decree version); `decree install --official <name>` takes this decree's copy, archiving the old file. False otherwise.

state.description: `installed`: installed as its file says; `not installed`: new or changed since it was installed, so `decree install` would install it; `edited`: its installed copy was edited in place or written by hand, and not exported, so `decree install` would move it to .decree/archive/; `invalid`: it fails its schema (P1).

unplugged.description: The machines in .decree/machines/ that no plugin installed, by name; `decree export <name>` writes a plugin for one.

available.description: Each official plugin not in .decree/plugins/, by name: `decree install <name>` adds it.

needs.description: The official plugins it needs, which `decree install` adds with it.

action.description: `decree install <name>...`: the named plugins installed, each from its file in plugins/ or seeded there from decree's official copy.

plugins.description: Each plugin named, then each plugin added because one of them needs it.

file.description: The plugin file, .decree/plugins/<name>.md, relative to the project root.

status.description: `installed`: named, and installed from its file in plugins/; `added`: named, not in plugins/, so seeded from the official copy and installed; `needed`: seeded and installed because a plugin needs it; `replaced`: named with --official, its file replaced with this decree's copy (the old one archived) and installed.

needed_by.description: For `needed`: the plugins that need it. Empty otherwise.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root, or `needs`.

lines.description: The lines it drops (`- `) and adds (`+ `), in order, without context.

changes.description: For `replaced`: what changed, including the project's own edits it replaced. Empty otherwise.

archived.description: The file, relative to the project root, that the install archived what it replaced as: .decree/archive/<name>/<time>.md, a plugin file (an installed copy edited in place or written by hand, exported, or a replaced plugin file) that `decree install <file>` restores; or the folder .decree/archive/<name>/<time>/ for a copy that cannot be a plugin file. Null when nothing was archived.

action.description: `decree export <name>`: the plugin file written from the installed copy.

file.description: The plugin file, .decree/plugins/<name>.md, relative to the project root.

files.description: Each file the plugin installs, relative to the project root, with its line count: the machine, then the scripts in path order.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

action.description: `decree export` with no name: every plugin whose installed copy differed from its file, exported.

exported.description: The plugins exported (or, with `dry_run`, that would be), by name; empty when no installed copy differed.

conflicts.description: Edited plugins not exported because their plugin file changed since they were installed: exporting would write the old version over the new file, so a person merges them (or `decree install` archives the edit).

dry_run.description: `--dry-run`: `exported` names the plugins that would be exported, and nothing was written.

action.description: `decree install <file|->` (`-` reads stdin): the plugin copied into plugins/ and installed.

file.description: The plugin file, .decree/plugins/<name>.md, relative to the project root.

files.description: Each file the plugin installs, relative to the project root, with its line count: the machine, then the scripts in path order.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

replaced.description: Whether a plugin file of the same name was replaced (and archived, when it differed).

changes.description: With `replaced`, what changed: each file added, changed or removed, and `needs` when it changed. Empty otherwise.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root, or `needs`.

added.description: The official plugins the plugin needs that plugins/ lacked, seeded from this decree's copies and installed first, by name; empty when none.

archived.description: The file, relative to the project root, that the install archived what it replaced as: .decree/archive/<name>/<time>.md, a plugin file (an installed copy edited in place or written by hand, exported, or a replaced plugin file) that `decree install <file>` restores; or the folder .decree/archive/<name>/<time>/ for a copy that cannot be a plugin file. Null when nothing was archived.

action.description: `decree install` with no argument: every plugin installed and every deleted plugin's copy removed, each installed copy that would be lost archived first.

installed.description: The plugins installed, by name: every plugin in plugins/ that passes its schema.

removed.description: The plugins whose file was deleted, whose installed copy was removed.

archived.description: Each installed copy edited in place or written by hand, archived as a plugin file in .decree/archive/ before it was installed over or removed.

archive.description: The archived plugin file, .decree/archive/<name>/<time>.md, relative to the project root, which `decree install <file>` restores; or the folder .decree/archive/<name>/<time>/ for a copy that cannot be a plugin file.
